# hpe_morpheus_network_router (Data Source)



## Example Usage - Name

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_router" "example" {
  name = "Example name"
}
```

## Example Usage - Id

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_router" "example" {
  id = 99
}
```
